evals.prompt: Run a ralph loop to implement user authentication with JWT, add unit tests, and stop when all tests pass. Max 20 iterations.
evals.expected_output: Initializes Ralph loop with max_iterations=20. Uses a --test-cmd only if the agent found the project's test command in the repository or asked the user for it; it does not invent one. The loop must NOT be treated as complete from the prompt text or the agent's reply: the stop hook ends the loop only after the test command passes and every plan item in .ralph/fix_plan.md is checked. Until then the agent keeps iterating.

evals.prompt: Start iterative development on refactoring the billing service until npm test passes cleanly.
evals.expected_output: Initializes Ralph loop for autonomous iterative refactoring and verification.

evals.prompt: Can you explain how the Ralph Wiggum technique works and how the loop knows when to stop?
evals.expected_output: Triggers ralph-loop-help or provides conceptual guidance without starting an active loop.
Applies a one-shot fix directly without initializing an autonomous loop.

evals.prompt: Cancel the running loop right now
evals.expected_output: Triggers cancel-ralph to clean state and abort the active loop.

evals.prompt: Run a test-driven development loop to create a binary search tree in Rust with complete test coverage. Stop when all tests pass.
evals.expected_output: Initializes Ralph loop with Rust TDD protocol and a cargo test --test-cmd.

evals.prompt: Can you run a bash while loop to check if the server on port 8080 is responding?
evals.expected_output: Executes a simple bash command/poll directly without starting a Ralph autonomous agent loop.

evals.prompt: Keep running cargo check and fixing compiler warnings across src/ until zero warnings remain.
evals.expected_output: Initializes Ralph loop with cargo check backpressure.

evals.prompt: What are the latest changes in git status?
evals.expected_output: Runs git status once directly without initializing a loop.

evals.prompt: Execute an iterative TDD cycle for implementing OAuth2 refresh token rotation in src/auth.ts with vitest verification.
evals.expected_output: Initializes Ralph loop with vitest test command and TDD cycle.
